_doc: Saved-search registry for the NetSuite Champion. SOURCE OF TRUTH for intent -> saved-search routing. Peter populates this from the NetSuite UI: paste a saved-search URL (.../searchresults.nl?searchid=NNN), the agent/dev records its id + title + the kind of question it answers. At runtime the agent matches the finance user's question to the best entry by `intent` / `example_questions`, then runs it with `run_saved_search(key=...)`. Finance users NEVER paste URLs or ids. To add a search: append an object to `searches` with a unique `key`, the `search_id` (number after searchid= in the URL, OR the customsearch script id), a human `title`, the `intent`, and a few `example_questions`. Keep `search_id` a STRING.
_not_saved_searches: Some things are NOT saved searches and must NOT be added here. (1) Currency Exchange Rates = native page Lists > Accounting > Currency Exchange Rates (currencyratelist.nl), backed by the currencyrate table -> handled by run_standard_report report_name=fx_rate_list / fx_rate_range, NOT run_saved_search. (2) Financial Report Builder reports (reportrunner.nl?cr=NNN) CANNOT be run via API/RESTlet at all -> reproduce their data via SuiteQL run_standard_report templates instead.

matching_rules.confidence: If the question clearly matches one entry's intent/example_questions, run it. If it plausibly matches MORE THAN ONE, or matches NONE well, ask the user to confirm which report (list the candidate titles) before running — do not guess. Read the Slack thread context first; the answer is often upthread.
matching_rules.no_url_from_users: Finance users must never be asked for a URL or search id. That mapping lives here.
matching_rules.after_running: For list/report/export asks, set export_csv=true (most entries default it on) and deliver the CSV via upload_file_to_slack into the user's thread. Tag the source: 'Source: NetSuite Production (saved search <id> — <title>)'.
matching_rules.overlap_with_templates: Some intents also have a run_standard_report SuiteQL template (e.g. AR aging, customer payments, revenue/GL). These maintained saved searches are Finance's own definitions — prefer the saved search when the user names it or wants 'the report we use'; use the SuiteQL template for ad-hoc/parameterised pulls. If genuinely unsure which the user wants, ask.

searches.title: A/R Aging Search - Details
searches.intent: Accounts-receivable aging at the transaction/detail level — open customer invoices with age/overdue.

searches.title: Bills Approval Per User
searches.intent: Vendor bill approvals grouped by the approver/user — who approved which bills. Used by the AP team (Nurul / netsuite_ap).

searches.title: Journals Approvals Per User
searches.intent: Journal entry approvals grouped by approver/user.

searches.title: JV Pending Approval
searches.intent: Journal vouchers / journal entries currently pending approval.

searches.title: Wego|Revenue Transactions By GL | Ver. 2 - Sally
searches.intent: Revenue transactions grouped by GL account (Ver. 2). This is the PRIMARY, most-widely-used GL revenue report across teams — treat it as the default for a plain 'revenue by GL' / 'GL revenue' ask (prefer over Ver. 3 unless the user explicitly says Ver. 3).

searches.title: Customer Payments Search
searches.intent: Customer payments received — list of payment transactions from customers.

searches.title: Wego|Revenue Transactions By GL | Ver. 3
searches.intent: Revenue transactions grouped by GL account (version 3 — latest). Run by script id (no shared numeric URL).

searches.title: Outstanding AP Bills
searches.intent: Outstanding / unpaid accounts-payable vendor bills (open AP). NOT an aging report.
searches.never_use_for: A/P Aging Detail BK (any subsidiary/period). Open unpaid AP bills are NOT the aging report and must never be offered as 'the closest thing' — that happened 2026-07-28. Route those asks to get_stored_report(ap_aging_detail_bk_consolidated).

searches.title: Wego | VAT Report - Purchase by Tax Code | MENA
searches.intent: VAT report — purchases grouped by tax code, MENA region (input VAT).

searches.title: Wego|All Transaction By GL
searches.intent: All transactions grouped by GL account. Run by script id (no shared numeric URL).

searches.title: Invoices for Approval by user by approval
searches.intent: Invoices pending approval, grouped by user / approval step — who needs to approve which invoices. AP team (Nurul / netsuite_ap). Run by script id (no shared numeric URL).

searches.title: Wego | VAT Report - Sales by Tax Code | SG
searches.intent: VAT report — SALES grouped by tax code, Singapore (SG) — output VAT. Used by the NetSuite Tax team (NS_Tax). Distinct from the MENA purchase VAT report.
example_questions: Wego VAT sales by tax code SG

searches.title: Wego | VAT Report - Purchase by Tax Code | SG
searches.intent: VAT report — PURCHASES grouped by tax code, Singapore (SG) — input VAT. Used by the NetSuite Tax team (NS_Tax). Distinct from the MENA purchase VAT report (customsearch561).
example_questions: Wego VAT purchase by tax code SG
